title: Grilled Lamb Skewers with Thai Peanut Sauce
description: A flavorful and aromatic dish featuring marinated lamb skewers grilled to perfection and served with a rich Thai peanut sauce.
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together fish sauce, soy sauce, lime juice, and honey. Add the lamb cubes and marinate for at least 30 minutes.
Thread lamb onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Grill skewers for 8-10 minutes per side, or until lamb reaches an internal temperature of 145°F (63°C).
Meanwhile, prepare the Thai peanut sauce by whisking together peanut butter, soy sauce, maple syrup, and fish sauce in a small bowl.
Brush the peanut sauce onto the lamb skewers during the last 2 minutes of grilling.
Serve lamb skewers hot with additional peanut sauce for dipping.
Garnish with cilantro and serve with steamed vegetables and rice.
